title: Immunohistochemistry for phospho-myosin light chain 2 in adult murine skin
protocol: Deparaffinize tissue sections by submerging them in xylol for 5 minutes.
Submerge the sections in fresh xylol for 5 minutes.
Transfer the sections into isopropanol for 5 minutes.
Soak the sections in 96% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Immerse the sections in 75% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Place the sections in 50% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Rinse the sections with H₂O for 5 minutes.
Boil the sections in Dako Antigen Retrieval Agent pH9 for 20 minutes inside a boiling cuvette.
Allow slides to cool down within the retrieval solution for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the tissue sections twice with PBS++ for 5 minutes each.
Delimit the tissue sections with a fat pen.
Block unspecific binding sites with 5% BSA in PBS++ for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber.
Incubate tissue sections with pMLC2 Ser19 primary antibody diluted at 1:200 overnight at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Incubate tissue sections with ppMLC2 Thr18/Ser19 primary antibody diluted at 1:100 overnight at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Incubate tissue sections with secondary antibodies and DAPI (2 µg/ml) for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber in the dark.
Wash the tissue sections 2 times with PBS++ for 5 minutes each.
Briefly wash the tissue sections 1 time with H2O.
Mount tissue sections in Mowiol. Ensure that the Mowiol solution covers the entire tissue section. Remove any air bubbles.
Cover with coverslip.
Let the Mowiol solidify for 24 hours (store dry in the dark at room temperature).
Seal slides with quick-dry nail polish.
Store samples in the cold and dark until further analysis.
